## Personality

Milty Boulter is known for the immense pride he takes in his mother. This stems from others praising her remarkable ability to eke out a living under the hardest conditions.

_Sources: [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P19](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0019)_

## History

Milty Boulter had been attending school for a year, which gave him the reputation of being quite a man of the world. Consequently, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) sat with him when he was at school.

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000)_

## Relationships

### [Simon Fletcher](../character/simon-fletcher.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/milty-boulter--simon-fletcher.md)

[Simon Fletcher](../character/simon-fletcher.md) is Milty's uncle, as Milty's mother is the sister of Simon's wife. Their familial connection establishes a direct maternal relationship between the two.

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011)_
